name: fault_codes
description: Use when you need the fault codes, the check-engine light (MIL), the readiness monitors, or the details and freeze frame of one code.
instructions: Triage already read the codes once. Call read_dtcs again only to re-check the stored, pending and permanent codes, the MIL state or the readiness monitors.
For each code that matters to the symptom, call read_dtcs_detail with that code, e.g. {"code":"P0401"}: description, system, VAG number, status now, freeze frame and this car's guide note.
Use the freeze frame (rpm, load, coolant, speed, MAP when the code set) to choose the live values to read next.

Call lookup_guide with a code, e.g. {"code":"P0401"}, or with a topic when there is no code, e.g. {"topic":"egr"}: this car's curated guide, the extended DIDs worth reading for it and the guided routine. It sends nothing to the car.
interpret: Stored (confirmed, mode 03): the ECU saw the fault on enough drive cycles to confirm it; an emissions fault usually turns the MIL on.
Pending (mode 07): seen once but not confirmed yet; intermittent or just starting. It becomes stored if it repeats and clears itself after several clean drive cycles.

Permanent (mode 0A): emissions codes a scan tool cannot erase; they clear only after the ECU's own monitor passes again. A permanent code without the stored one means it was cleared but not re-tested yet.
MIL on: the ECU asks for service now. MIL off with stored codes: a non-emissions or history fault, rarely urgent on its own.
Readiness: monitors not complete are normal for a while after codes were cleared or the battery was disconnected; many incomplete monitors and no codes suggest a recent clear.
The VAG 5-digit number is the same fault as the P code (its two bytes in decimal); use it to match VCDS logs.
The guide note lists this car's known causes; confirm them with live data before naming a part.

lookup_guide's related DIDs are this car's extended data for the fault: read them with read_extended when it is offered. A routine in the guide is something the user runs from the Routines screen; the agent never runs it, so suggest it in the report instead.
No curated guide means only that nobody wrote one for this code on this car yet, not that the code is harmless.
